title: Leonardo da Vinci given information by aliens

tellings.quote: the Talmud. Or take Leonardo da Vinci for example. He was given information as well.

plain: Leonardo da Vinci got some of his knowledge from aliens, according to a guest named Kiran Ilum Xenov, who says on the show that he himself was taken by aliens in 1997. He tells Michels that Leonardo "was given information," and sets him alongside the Talmud as another case of knowledge passed to humans from outside, without saying how he knows.
